title: Your Life in the Bratva at Every Rank (You Never Own It)
hook: Steam so thick the door disappears. A straight razor rests flat against your knuckles, not yours, not moving. Ded Grisha's voice comes from somewhere in the white: did you talk. Don't blink first.
body: POV: a composite Russian organized-crime figure who climbs the real, documented vory v zakone hierarchy -- Patsan (a courtyard prospect) to Boyevik (enforcer) to Brigadir (crew leader) to Avtoritet (a made authority with a legitimate front) to Smotryashchiy (a district overseer) to Vor v Zakone via koronatsiya, the real crowning ceremony bound by the thieves' code -- no marriage, no state job, no property, ever -- to a foreign cell (grounded in the real 1992 Solntsevskaya dispatch of Vyacheslav 'Yaponchik' Ivankov to Brighton Beach) to Pakhan, nominal boss of an obshchak he can never personally spend. Real, verified mechanics woven in: the obshchak's actual 5-20% profit levy funding jailed members' families and legal defense; the mid-1990s krysha (protection) racket that a Yeltsin-era report found covering 70-90% of Russian businesses at 10-20% of turnover; and prison tattoos as a coded resume -- stars for never kneeling to police, epaulettes for rank, cathedral domes for sentences served. Ded Grisha (the mentor) and Zoloto (the rival) are a FICTIONAL COMPOSITE; no real figure is depicted as this episode's protagonist. Watch the whole series -- every life, every level, every rank the code decides isn't really yours to keep. For educational and entertainment purposes.
pinned: Real fact: a mid-1990s Yeltsin-administration report found 70-90% of Russia's private businesses and banks in major cities were paying "krysha" (roof) tribute to organized crime -- 10-20% of their entire turnover, just to be left alone. Which level do you think costs the most: the koronatsiya that surrenders everything to the fund, or the day you're the one giving that order?
poll: Which level costs the most? LEVEL 02 (Boyevik -- the first real violence, no going back) / LEVEL 06 (Vor v Zakone -- $0, everything surrendered to the fund) / LEVEL 07 (The Export -- a one-way ticket, no return date) / LEVEL 08 (Pakhan -- $60M moves through you, none of it yours)
